newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica shares rise on H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica shares rise on H1 results.

text.p: Shares in Spanish telecommunications group Telefonica rose 35 pesetas to 2,355 after the company announced net profit rose 19.5 percent in the first half of 1996.
Net profit was 71.88 billion pesetas, slightly below market forecasts of 72.5 billion.
The share price fell back to 2,335 moments after the announcement.
"The results are pretty good," said Luis Prota, analyst at AB Asesores in Madrid. "They're in line with expectations -- I was looking for a rise of 20 percent."
Prota said the results had been mostly discounted, explaining the moderate share price reaction.
"The share is very cheap but the results weren't enough of a surprise to motivate people to buy," he said.
